**Match Details:**
⚽ Italy vs. Germany (UEFA Euro 2012 Semi-Final)
🗓️ June 28, 2012
🏟️ National Stadium, Warsaw, Poland
🏆 UEFA Euro 2012

**Goals:**
* 0-1: Mario Balotelli (20')
